children: According to ChainCatcher citing The Defiant, OpenRouter removed 125 endpoints from its zero data retention eligibility list during an expanded vendor review, including endpoints associated with MiniMax. Novita confirmed that it had forwarded some MiniMax requests to model developer MiniMax, making those requests ineligible for zero data retention. OpenRouter consequently removed the labels from the affected MiniMax endpoints.

title: OpenRouter Removes Zero Data Retention Labels From MiniMax Endpoints
